assumptions.name: EVENTUAL_DELIVERY_FOR_RETAINED_EXPORT
assumptions.text: If a retained export remains eligible for delivery, delivery is not postponed forever.

assumptions.name: EVENTUAL_IMPORT_OBSERVATION
assumptions.text: If a delivered export remains eligible for target observation, observation is not postponed forever.

assumptions.assurance_projection: A profile-composition assurance may use Resolve(e) only as a witness of target-local Seed terminal progress.
assumptions.name: TARGET_LOCAL_SEED_EVENTUAL_RESOLUTION
assumptions.text: If target-local Seed resolution for an admitted import remains enabled, that local Seed decision is not postponed forever. This is an external composition assumption, not a Network-owned transition.

assumptions.name: NO_PERMANENT_TARGET_UNAVAILABILITY
assumptions.text: A target required for progress is not permanently unavailable or withdrawn while the progress guarantee is claimed.

guarantees.name: EVENTUALLY_TARGET_LOCAL_SEED_RESOLVED
guarantees.text: Under the declared target-local Seed progress assumption, an admitted import eventually reaches a target-local Seed terminal result.

scope_rule: Liveness is an independent optional profile. It adds no Network state or transitions and may be composed with any profile that provides its required progress capabilities. Terminal resolution remains owned by the pinned target-local Seed.
